verdict.rationale: Salesmate's own pricing docs mention workflow automations powered by smart flow credits, and its site says it can update CRM records, fields, and activities autonomously, so a native automation capability exists. The evidence never shows how workflows are triggered or what actions they support, and the record-update claim appears in an AI-agent context rather than the workflow builder. missing for 10: documented trigger types, a create-task action, a send-notification action, workflow builder documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build trigger-based workflows that update records, create tasks, and send notifications automatically

citations.quote: With extra smart flow credits, scale your workflow automations and automate your end-to-end sales and marketing playbooks.
Update CRM records, fields, and activities autonomously without manual intervention
